en: Color photograph of a large equestrian statue in front of a Gothic church with a steep red-tiled roof and clock tower. The foreground shows a monumental bronze group around a stone pedestal, with the central rider on horseback elevated above several standing and kneeling figures holding flags. Decorative pennant banners hang along the church façade, and a bed of flowers borders the base of the monument.
